descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S12 Existing specs: task review has Copy and no email path, Hospital and Nursing Home

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 No email or mailto that carries patient data, on any screen that shows patient data, in Hospital and in Nursing Home: no PHI is transmitted through an unencrypted path. … (UAT OAT-02 step 3; UAT OAT-02; UAT 3.3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Probe patients with open tasks in each mode

When Open /rounding/tasks and /snf/tasks

Then No Email button and no mailto: link in either mode. Copy Text is the only way out (Hospital clipboard checked).

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions (getByRole button /Email/ and a[href^=mailto:] toHaveCount(0)) in both modes, which satisfies 3.3

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S12 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: OAT-02 Encryption Verification · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-02/S12

Existing specs: task review has Copy and no email path, Hospital and Nursing Home

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress)

Result: passed in matrix/OAT-02.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • task-export.spec.ts [chromium] — the hospital task review has Copy and no email path — expected
  • task-export.spec.ts [chromium] — the nursing-home task review lists today's residents and has no email path — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's Playwright spec e2e/task-export.spec.ts, chromium): it seeds the probe patients and residents with createRoundingPatient / createSnfResident through e2e/support/backend.ts with the local admin key; dev has no admin key, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
